title: P18-C parallel admission gating — DEPENDS_ON/CONFLICTS constraints on the auto-scheduler claim path
description: P18-C: the canonical relation substrate now GATES autonomous admission (first non-inert consumer). New ObjectiveRelationService.admissionView — STRICT enumeration of ACTIVE DEPENDS_ON upstreams + CONFLICTS partners: corrupt relation rows propagate loudly (a corrupted-but-real edge can never silently clear admission), semantic unproven-ness (forged/owner-amended edges) drops rows so fabrication can never gate. Shared scheduler predicate relationGate: UPSTREAM_UNMET when any ACTIVE DEPENDS_ON upstream is not ACHIEVED (pending AND terminally-failed both block — only owner action resolves FAILED); CONFLICT_LEASE_HELD when an ACTIVE CONFLICTS partner holds a live lease — mutual exclusion on the parallel lane. Wired at all three claim-path seams with one predicate: claimable() (read-only readiness — new honest reasons flow to driver readiness; roster view is a read-only mirror since claimable never mutates), nextFairCandidate() (relation-gated candidates skipped transiently — furthest advances, re-enters next rotation; one activeRoster snapshot per scan, also reaps stale leases so an expired partner can't hold a conflict closed; corrupt relations propagate — admission authority never scans an unprovable graph), claim() (gate re-proven atomically with the roster under the same immediate tx as the lease mint — a DEPENDS_ON minted or CONFLICTS partner claimed mid-race cannot slip through). Admission-only: relations minted mid-execution never retroactively kill a live lease; settle/renew/assert paths untouched. Manual/operator admission unaffected — the gate binds only the autonomous scheduler lane. Codex-only.
